_comment: Generic fable-prep config. Copy to config.json and edit. Empty arrays trigger auto-detect via lib/detect.sh.

scoring._note: qual = round-collapse (entry ticket). If a cheaper model one-shots it too, qual ~ 0 -> dropped to a normal board card, not the frontier queue.

hard_constraints: archive never delete (move to _archive/, never rm)
branch policy main-only unless repo has .sigma/dev-flow
every done carries its machine_check output (verify never assert)
design/copy/marketing packets run on the frontier model directly, never re-delegated
